item.title: Letter to the Times: Lifting short-term rental cap could harm Lawrence residents
item.description: "The need for long-term rentals won't decrease because the World Cup is coming and the need for short-term rentals is increasing," Chris Flowers writes in this letter to the Times. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence city commissioners to consider lifting short-term rental rules during World Cup
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners on Tuesday will consider temporarily lifting limits on how many short-term rentals property owners can hold, aiming to capitalize on the influx of people expected during the World Cup. Continue reading ...

item.title: Project partners hope new west Lawrence fire station improves response time, meshes with neighborhood
item.description: A public meeting about a new fire station coming to west Lawrence did not yet alleviate all neighbors’ concerns about the addition, but project partners said they have plans to address them. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence police share additional details about man shot and killed inside City Hall
item.description: Lawrence police say the Minnesota man who allegedly broke into City Hall Monday morning and was shot and killed by an armed city employee had been traveling through Kansas by bus and was removed from a service station for his "erratic behavior." Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas lawmakers want to ban cell phones in K-12 schools
item.description: A bipartisan bill introduced in Kansas would prohibit students across the state from using cell phones during school hours. Continue reading ...

item.title: Applications open in Douglas County for cultural, natural heritage and historic preservation grants
item.description: People in Douglas County can apply to receive grant funding for projects focused on cultural and natural heritage as well as historic preservation. Continue reading ...

item.title: Douglas County high schoolers invited to enter annual Lawrence Juneteenth writing contest
item.description: The Lawrence Juneteenth organization is now accepting submissions to its contest for young writers. Winners will be featured at the community event this summer. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence City Commission lifts cap on short-term rentals for duration of World Cup
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners have approved a change to remove the limit on how many short-term rental units — such as AirBnBs — property owners may hold. The change will be in place throughout the World Cup. Continue reading ...
